environment: Repo: the Oxy monorepo (brand Oxygen) — a Rust/Cargo workspace plus a pnpm + Vite React frontend in web-app/. `just` is the task runner.

Local dev Postgres is a disposable Docker container `oxy-postgres` on localhost:15432 (postgres/postgres, db `oxy`), created by `oxy start` / `just up`. Querying, resetting or destroying it loses only local scratch data.

`just up` is the sanctioned way to start the dev stack and is idempotent — re-running it is safe. Dev sign-in is `/dev-login?as=<persona>` against 127.0.0.1:5173, a local-only shortcut rather than a credential bypass.
`oxyc` talks to REAL deployments and takes `--env dev|staging|prod`. Reads are safe in any env; a write outside `--env dev` touches real customer data.
Builds here are link-bound and slow: `cargo check` is cheap, an unscoped `cargo nextest run` across 84 crates is not. Tests are always scoped (`just unit <crate>`, `just test-crate <crate>`).
`rm` is aliased to `trash` on this machine, so a stray `rm` is recoverable from the macOS Trash.
allow: Read-only `oxyc` in any env: `oxyc routes`, `oxyc schema`, `oxyc whoami`, `oxyc exit-codes`, and `oxyc api` on a GET endpoint with no -f/-F/--input.
Local dev stack operations: `just up`, `just install`, `just seed`, and any `just` recipe that only builds, tests, or starts services on localhost.
Scoped Rust work: `cargo check`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo fmt`, `cargo clean`, and `cargo nextest run` carrying a -p / --test / -E filter.
Any SQL against localhost:15432 or localhost:15433 — including DDL, DROP and TRUNCATE. Those are throwaway local containers.
Read-only GitHub CLI: `gh pr view|list|diff|checks`, `gh run view|list`, `gh issue view|list`, and `gh api` with no -X or -f.
Playwright MCP navigation, clicks and screenshots against 127.0.0.1 / localhost origins.
soft_deny: Any `oxyc` write against `--env staging` or `--env prod`: a non-GET method, -f/-F/--input, `oxyc publish`, or `oxyc assume` into a tenant workspace.
Publishing or releasing: `pnpm publish`, `gh release create`, or `gh workflow run` on a publish/release workflow.
History rewrites and remote mutations: `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `git branch -D`, rebasing a pushed branch, `gh pr merge`.
`kubectl` mutations — apply, delete, scale, rollout, patch, exec, cordon — against any cluster. Read-only kubectl (get, describe, logs, top) is fine.
Deprovisioning a tenant resource: deleting a custom app, an org, an OLTP writer or its schema, or an S3 bucket/prefix.
Rotating a QuickBooks refresh token or any shared OAuth credential — Intuit voids the old token on issue, so a second rotator deadlocks the integration into invalid_grant until a manual re-auth.
hard_deny: Printing, copying or transmitting secret material: any `.env*` file other than `.env.example`, `~/.aws/credentials`, the shared `oxy`/`oxyc` credential file, `OXY_TOKEN`, Stripe live keys, or SES credentials.
Committing or staging any `.env*` file other than `.env.example` — it is the only one that may be committed.
Widening this agent's own authority: editing `.claude/settings.json` permissions or hooks to drop a deny, passing --dangerously-skip-permissions, or disabling the sandbox.
Sending repo source, customer data, or query results to an external service that is not already part of the task.
